title.v: The backstop's parking pause ends on a timer, or on any successful wsMUSD withdraw (even one wsMUSD pays from its own idle MUSD), while sMUSD's withdraw is still broken; the next deposit or sale re-parks the venue's cash and quotes still show the venue as open

note.v: The pause will follow wsMUSD's health (a probe withdraw that must reach sMUSD), not a timer, and quotes stay capped at idle cash while paused

title.v: During the pause, an exit paid in kind spends the venue's idle MUSD first, even when the backstop's wsMUSD could pay it

note.v: Pay in kind from the wsMUSD position first

title.v: A 1 MUSD top-up (supply, rebalance, withdraw in one transaction) takes the block's only buffer top-up and throttles restoration to 1 MUSD per block

note.v: Limit top-ups by amount per block, not by count

title.v: One touched checkpoint an hour can carry a recorded liquidity low forward indefinitely, blocking the move to wsMUSD

note.v: A touched checkpoint records share prices but no liquidity observation, so a low ages out 24 h after it was seen

title.v: The 600 s Pyth band cuts both ways: between Mezo's hourly Pyth pushes it is off, so a Skip misprint above 10% gets through; and anyone can keep it on with genuine but lagged Pyth prints, stretching a crash-time freeze past 10 minutes

note.v: job pushes the latest Pyth BTC/USD print once the stored one is over 240 s old, and the liquidation job pushes one before simulating, so the band stays on and Pyth rejects older prints. It runs once a Hermes API key is set.
